nodes.label: ShellSmash Gaming Hub Main Screen Concept Art
nodes.description: Dual-panel concept art for the Shell Smash Gaming Hub. Top panel: main hub map with sections for Arena (Shell Smash 1v1 online), Cartas (Shell Cards), Tienda, Mapa (Explora zonas), Ranking, and Eventos (Próximamente). Player profile KameMaster shown with stats (122 victories, 248 defeats, rank 7, win rates by mode). Navigation tabs: Personaliza, Mi Perfil, Colecciones, Logros. Bottom panel: Shell Cards collection interface showing card categories (Tortugas 24/60, Técnicas 80/85, Espíritus 12/40, Equipamiento 15/25, Lugares 9/25), card rarity filters (Todas, Común, Poco Común, Rara, Épica, Legendaria), featured card Tortuga Ronin (Guerrero, Fuerza 5, Guardia 4, Ki 3, Contraataque ability), and current deck Guerreros del Mar.
